Hamstr 0.3.0 keeps a video in several qualities, saves audio out of videos and lets Cheek update on its own.

- **Qualities:** tap the quality in the player, or **Quality** in the file menu. Switch between the files on your phone at the same spot, delete one, or fetch more (sizes are estimated). **Keep both** adds the new file next to the current one; **Replace** deletes the current file only once the new one is in.
- Stash and Library show a link once with all its files, for example `[ 1080P · 720P · M4A ]`. Finished downloads record their real resolution.
- **Save audio** pulls the sound out of a stashed video right on the phone, with no new download. The audio stream is copied as it is when possible. It also works for imported videos.
- **Send notifications** in Settings → Queue & storage shows whether Hamstr may notify you and helps turn it back on after the permission was denied.
- **Cheek updates itself** from its own GitHub releases, once a day or with **Check version** / **Update now** in Settings → Engine. Downloads are checked against `SHA256SUMS.txt`; Hamstr only takes compatible releases (for 0.x the same minor version) and keeps the bundled **Cheek 0.1.1** as a fallback.
- The player and fullscreen video have a **More options** button with the file menu. Deleting a file closes the player when it shows that file.
- The share sheet's falling preview stops when a link fails, for example on DRM.

Install over the previous release or use Settings → About. APK signatures use the same release key; verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
